results.title: Drizzle ORM migrations on PGlite (in-memory Postgres)
results.summary: Apply versioned SQL migrations with Drizzle's PGlite migrator, use Postgres features (jsonb, enums, arrays, onConflictDoUpdate) and test against a fresh in-memory database.

results.title: Drizzle ORM + PGlite in-memory Postgres
results.summary: Real Postgres semantics in tests with no server: Drizzle ORM on PGlite (WASM Postgres) with relations, returning() and transactions.

results.title: Auth.js Drizzle adapter on PGlite Postgres (database sessions)
results.summary: Set up @auth/drizzle-adapter with the standard Postgres tables on Drizzle, and test user, account linking and database session lifecycle against in-memory PGlite.

results.title: pg-mem in-memory Postgres with Kysely for fast DB tests
results.summary: Run Kysely queries against pg-mem through its node-postgres adapter: serial ids, RETURNING, a frozen now(), unique/check/foreign-key constraints, atomic multi-row inserts, joins with aggregates, and snapshot restore (pg-mem does not roll back multi-query transactions).

results.title: cockatiel retry, circuit breaker and timeout policies
results.summary: Compose cockatiel policies with wrap(): retries with backoff, a consecutive-failure circuit breaker that throws BrokenCircuitError, and an aggressive timeout, all with real but tiny delays.

results.title: Boltons retry decorator and cached property helpers under pytest
results.summary: A signature-preserving retry decorator composed with boltons.funcutils.wraps, plus cacheutils cachedproperty and cachedmethod memoization tested offline with pytest.

results.title: undici HTTP client with p-retry backoff, tested with MockAgent
results.summary: A JSON client on undici.request wrapped in p-retry that retries 429, 5xx and network errors but aborts on other 4xx, tested offline with undici MockAgent, disableNetConnect and assertNoPendingInterceptors.

results.title: Axios + axios-retry with exponential backoff, tested with nock
results.summary: Configure axios-retry for idempotent requests and 429/5xx responses, tested offline with nock intercepts.

results.title: devalue serialization with cycles and repeated refs
results.summary: Serialize and parse values with devalue, covering cyclic references, Dates, Maps and repeated refs, and assert that functions throw offline.

results.title: Vue 3 + Pinia store and component tests with @pinia/testing (Vitest)
results.summary: Test a Pinia setup store directly and a Vue 3 component that uses it with @vue/test-utils and createTestingPinia (stubbed actions, initial state), on jsdom.
